verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a graph view that visualizes links between notes and shows the 'local neighbourhood' around an open note, plus backlinks and block-based linking that build the underlying connection graph. However, there is no evidence of interactive filtering (e.g., by tag, object type, or search query) within the graph view itself, which the story explicitly requires. Missing for 10: documented filtering/query controls in graph view, evidence of exploring the whole knowledge base graph (not just local neighborhood), independent/hands-on confirmation of graph interactivity.
